Package nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.spigot.core.config

@NullMarked package nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.spigot.core.config
This package contains classes responsible for handling the configuration files used by the plugin.

The ConfigSpigot class handles all interactions with the configuration file, including reading values, setting values, and saving changes. Default values are provided for all configuration options, so if a user does not have a configuration file, one will be generated with default values.
